scope: Current factual research package for the members-only, five-player combat minigame at the Barbarian Outpost. It proposes future normalized records only. It does not select a route, team, role, completion target, point target, gamble target, reward, combat setup, or readiness state.

included: current tutorial gate, location and factual transport alternatives, team/role structure, calls, ten-wave loop, Penance Queen procedure, reset and death boundaries
role-specific honour-point mechanics, caps, level-up costs, shop costs, Queen gates, resale behavior, gamble tiers, and deterministic versus RNG distinctions
Kandarin medium, hard, and elite diary linkages, including the hard-diary 10 percent honour-point increase and the all-role-level-5 elite requirement
proposed report-only observations for participation, team state, calls, waves, point balances, role levels, Queen kills, purchases, gambles, and collection-log state
excluded: whether Barbarian Assault, a fighter torso, role levels, a Queen kill, gambles, Penance equipment, granite body, or collection-log entries should be pursued now

fixed time, XP, GP, food, potion, ammunition, rune, death, or point-per-hour estimates, because they depend on team composition, execution, combat state, role, diary state, and chosen activity
community recruiting standards, role order, advanced tactics, team composition, stopping points, or equipment recommendations, except where explicitly marked strategy-candidate-not-fact

Role-specific scoring formulas, wave 10 awards, team penalties, 5,000-per-role cap, role-level costs/effects, all shop costs, resale amount, and high-gamble pet rate.

requirements.tutorial: The Barbarian Assault tutorial must be completed at least once before participating or using the Grouping teleport. Completion is player-observed.
requirements.team_gate: A normal game requires five joined players: one Collector, Defender, Healer, and Attacker, with the fifth player taking Attacker or Healer. Accept Aid must be enabled to join a team. Team availability, invitations, acceptance, roles, and leader selection are external player observations.
requirements.combat: No universal combat-level requirement is imposed by the activity. Combat gear, supplies, survival, and any practical combat suitability remain player-confirmed rather than inferred.

location_and_transport: Barbarian Assault is at the Barbarian Outpost, north of Baxtorian Falls in Kandarin.
Games necklace: Barbarian Outpost is a direct transport capability only when an observed charged necklace or its independently modeled source state is available.
Grouping teleport: direct Barbarian Assault transport becomes available after the player-observed tutorial completion; it does not establish a team, current lobby, game, or wave.
Lunar Barbarian Teleport: level 75 Magic on Lunar spellbook, with 3 fire, 2 astral, and 2 law runes, is a separate factual transport path.
Tree Gnome Stronghold shortcut: requires observed 37 Agility and The Grand Tree completion, then approaches from the east.
Enchanted lyre: a factual Rellekka transport alternative followed by travel through the Lighthouse approach; its charge and quest state are external transport observations.

unlock_transition.event: player confirms tutorial completion and an accepted team state
deterministic_effects: the player may be eligible to join or form a game and select a role
the Grouping teleport becomes an available travel option after tutorial completion
non_effects: does not create a five-player team
does not establish calls, wave success, points, local equipment, Queen access, rewards, or completion

entry_inputs.behavior: persistent participation gate; must be explicitly observed
external social state; normal composition contains Collector, Defender, Healer, and one or two Attackers/Healers
Attacker, Collector, Defender, or Healer; selection is player-observed and uses the matching local horn/equipment
ordinary inventory/equipment may be carried into the instanced activity. No specific setup, quantity, consumption, death, or readiness is inferred.

reusable_setup.effect: Attacker reads Collector calls and kills Penance Fighters/Rangers with the called attack style. Local arrows/runes are provided by the Attacker item machine; calls and kills remain observed.
Collector reads Healer calls, collects the called red/green/blue eggs, and may load eggs into launchers. Wrong eggs can explode; collection and conversion outcomes are observed.

Defender reads Attacker calls, obtains tofu/worms/crackers from the Defender item machine, lures runners, and can use the runner trap. Calls, food placement, runner behavior, and kills remain observed.

reusable_setup.item_or_capability: Healer horn, healing vial, poisoned food
reusable_setup.effect: Healer reads Defender calls, uses healing vial on players, takes poison food from the Healer item machine, and applies the called food to Penance Healers. Heals, food selection, poison applications, and kills remain observed.
A prospective leader can take a scroll, write a role, and invite four ungrouped players. It represents an attempted social transition, not a guaranteed team.

core_actions: kill Penance Fighters and Rangers using the Collector-provided attack style
call the Defender's food type at the changing call interval
collect egg color requested by Healer
load eggs into launchers or pass Queen yellow eggs through the Queen sequence
obtain and place called bait to direct Penance Runners
heal team members with healing vial
use called poison food on Penance Healers
call the Collector's requested egg color

role_actions_and_calls.call_rule: Each role reads the ear icon for its own current instruction and uses its horn's mouth icon to call the adjacent role's instruction. Calls change during a wave. No chosen role, call, timing, or correct execution is assumed from entry.

facts: A leader recruits or players wait for an open role. The leader can keep or remove members between waves.
If no teammate leaves or is removed after a completed wave, the next wave starts automatically after 60 seconds.
Leaving, removing a teammate, reset, failure, or unsuccessful social coordination can end the attempted sequence. It does not award unobserved points or progress.
The team handles Penance Fighters, Rangers, Runners, and Healers with role-specific calls/actions.
A wave completes only after the qualifying Penance monsters are defeated. Completion, personal actions, and score remain player-observed.
The team receives role-specific honour point results only at a successful wave completion, subject to team performance and individual role performance.
Wave 10 has a distinct layout and Queen encounter. The Queen appears after other Penance are defeated or four minutes pass.
The Queen uses long-distance Ranged attacks against all five players, may melee nearby players, and can spawn melee Queen spawns. Damage, deaths, kills, and survival are observed.

The team creates omega eggs: Collector collects yellow eggs; Healer poisons them; Attacker adds spikes; Defender adds lava; Collector loads the egg hopper. Eight omega-egg hits are needed to kill the Queen.
Wrong-action point penalties do not apply on wave 10, but the Penance creatures still require correct calls. Queen completion and Queen-kill count are never inferred.
At each successful wave, role-specific point deltas are displayed. They must be recorded rather than derived from selected role or time spent.
Commander Connad spends a chosen role's points for levels, equipment, or gambles. Purchases and gambles occur only after explicit observed balances and player-confirmed choice.

completion_or_reward_events.effect: A displayed role-specific honour-point result may be recorded. It depends on team and personal performance and is bounded by role caps and penalties.

Player receives 80 points in the role played and 5 points in each other role, before applicable diary bonus rules. It permits Queen-gated shop purchases and high gamble eligibility after explicit confirmation.
Exact selected role-point and/or coin costs can be removed, and the selected deterministic item/level can be recorded after a player-confirmed transaction.
Exact point cost and entrance prerequisite can be verified, but the reward result, quantity, and Penance pet remain player-observed.

failure_and_death.safe_activity: Barbarian Assault is a safe activity in an instanced area: death does not lose carried items or items held by an Item Retrieval Service, but manually dropped ground items are lost. It remains dangerous for Hardcore Group Iron players.
failure_and_death.wave_failure: A failed/reset/abandoned wave, departure, kick, unavailable teammate, incorrect call, missed role action, monster escape, or player death does not automatically award a completion, point delta, or Queen kill. Actual result must be reported.
failure_and_death.point_penalty_boundary: For waves 1-9, escaped runners, wrong attack styles, and wrong Healer poison-food uses can reduce point scores under capped penalty rules. Team and individual point totals have a minimum of zero. The model records displayed deltas rather than calculating an unobserved performance score.
failure_and_death.team_continuity: The leader can change the roster between waves. The 60-second automatic next-wave start applies only if no member leaves or is removed. No future wave, team continuity, or reset timing is inferred.

repeatability.team_dependence: Every game requires contemporaneous coordination with a five-player team. A role choice or travel capability never establishes that team availability.
persistent_values: four separate role-point balances, each capped at 5,000
role levels 1 through 5 after confirmed purchases
purchased Penance equipment and collection-log entries
repeatability.no_global_completion: There is no universal one-time completion. Tutorial, individual waves, Queen kills, role levels, diary tasks, equipment purchases, and gambles are distinct observed states.

currencies.spend_behavior: Role-specific balance; spent on Attacker level upgrades, four-role equipment costs, or selected-role gambles. Cannot be transferred to other role balances.
Role-specific balance; spent on Collector level upgrades, four-role equipment costs, or selected-role gambles. Cannot be transferred to other role balances.
Role-specific balance; spent on Defender level upgrades, four-role equipment costs, or selected-role gambles. Cannot be transferred to other role balances.
Role-specific balance; spent on Healer level upgrades, four-role equipment costs, or selected-role gambles. Cannot be transferred to other role balances.
Granite body requires 95,000 observed coins in addition to each-role honour points and a confirmed Queen kill. Coins are not produced or assumed by this package.

honour_point_rules.general: For waves 1-9, each player gets team-performance points plus points from individual role actions; subsequent waves yield higher base values. Role-specific point calculations and performance are not automatic account transitions.

components: Fighters killed: x - 1, capped by spawns
Rangers killed: x - 1, capped by spawns
incorrect-style attacks: -x + 1, capped at -10; the Attacker has one free wrong hit per wave
eggs collected minus exploded: x / 4.35, with collected count capped at 60
wrong egg explosions also damage the Collector; result remains observed
Runners that get past: -3x, capped at -10 for individual scoring; team escape penalty applies separately
players' hitpoints replenished: x / 18, capped at 28
wrong poison packs: -x / 4, with wrong-pack count capped at 512

team_penalties: Each escaped Runner subtracts 3 final honour points from everyone, to a maximum penalty of 10; the Defender's loss is doubled.
Each wrong attack style subtracts 1 final honour point from everyone, to a maximum penalty of 10.
Each four wrong poison packs subtracts 1 final honour point from everyone, to a maximum penalty of 10.
Team points and total wave points cannot fall below zero.
honour_point_rules.wave_10: A confirmed Queen kill awards 80 points in the played role and 5 points in each other role instead of waves 1-9 formulas. The 10 percent Kandarin hard bonus applies to earned points and is rounded down; implementation must use an observed diary tier and observed display rather than assume it.
honour_point_rules.storage_boundary: Role balances cap at 5,000 each. A cap describes storage capacity, not actual points, point loss, or transaction eligibility.

dependencies_and_bypasses.detail: An observed completed Barbarian Assault wave can satisfy the task event after tutorial/qualifying diary state; the package must not award it automatically.
Observed Kandarin hard completion provides 10 percent more honour points, rounded down. It changes a confirmed earned-point calculation/display, not team success.
Observed role level 5 in all four roles is required before the blackboard task can be completed; the diary task itself must be separately observed.
Commander Connad offers a deterministic purchase after 375 observed points in each role and a confirmed Queen kill; the activity only makes the conditions obtainable.
Confirmed purchases can add the eight Penance/Granite item entries. Gamble pet result is separate RNG and all log state remains observed.
Tutorial completion unlocks the Grouping teleport capability, but current teleport readiness and arrival remain observed.
Granite body is a deterministic shop path with 95,000 coins, 50 points in each role, and Queen kill, but it is not treated as a route recommendation or a substitute for any unmodeled equipment goal.

logout_or_idle_constraints: A normal game depends on timely changing calls, role actions, movement, combat, and team coordination.
No universal idle interval is asserted. It varies by role, wave, team execution, combat state, and player choice.
Leaving, reset, death, team changes, and lack of teammates can interrupt an attempt; no unattended completion, points, or rewards are inferred.
afk_and_attention.source_boundary: Community terms such as leech, casual, efficient, low-effort, service, or role-free are not factual passive-progression classifications. Every completion and balance change remains an observed event.

community_strategy_observations.claim: Community guides commonly suggest finishing a Queen round before seeking the hard Kandarin diary point bonus, then using that bonus for later point goals.
Community teams often use two Attackers early and sometimes switch the second Attacker to Healer for late waves or the Queen, with alternatives based on combat and team needs.
Community guides propose role order, recruitment etiquette, supplied-gear choices, advanced defender food placement, Queen rotations, and torso or diary stopping goals.

state_boundaries: Never infer membership, tutorial completion, Accept Aid setting, location, charged Games necklace, Grouping teleport readiness, Lunar spellbook, runes, quest state, shortcut access, or arrival from a planned activity.

Never infer team availability, group composition, leader, invite, acceptance, role selection, teammate behavior, calls, correct actions, local machine supplies, current wave, elapsed time, combat setup, player health, damage, death, kill, success, reset, Queen completion, or continuation.

All honour-point balances and deltas are player-reported/display-observed. Role selection, elapsed waves, formulas, or a diary tier must never auto-credit points, losses, 10-percent bonuses, caps, or gamble eligibility.

Role levels, Queen kills, purchases, equipment possession, item resale, coins, gamble entry, gamble result, pet, collection-log entries, and diary-task completion are explicit observations. Costs may be validated only after those observations are supplied.

A reward transaction is deterministic only when all selected role balances, Queen gate where applicable, selected item, observed coin state where applicable, and player-confirmed transaction are present. It never grants team participation or prior waves.
The activity is safe for normal item-loss purposes but Hardcore Group Iron risk and manually dropped-item loss remain warnings, not automatically inferred deaths or survival state.

conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: Current Wiki documentation says the in-game Defender level display is false: upgrades beyond level 2 do not actually improve lure range, even though level 5 is still required for Kandarin elite. Preserve both displayed and actual-behavior facts; do not derive an increasing post-level-2 range model.

Published formulas describe components but runtime point results depend on spawns, calls, individual actions, team penalties, rounding, role, wave, and Kandarin hard state. Record displayed deltas rather than automatically calculate unobserved balances.

Gamble prices and entry gates are exact, but all reward tables, quantities, rare armour/resource results, and the 1/1000 high-gamble Penance Queen pet are RNG/player-observed. No gamble is a deterministic acquisition path.

The normal safe-activity wording explicitly warns that the activity remains dangerous for Hardcore Group Iron players. A future Hardcore model needs a separate death-risk policy before translating this into readiness or route advice.

The existing Kandarin package uses wiki-barbarian-assault and wiki-kandarin-diary. This package uses current-suffixed IDs for dated revalidation; an integrator should alias sources rather than duplicate factual claims.

This package treats the eight deterministic shop item entries as possible collection-log records after confirmed purchase. The Penance Queen pet remains a separate high-gamble RNG result; role levels and point balances are not collection-log entries.
